description: A user who forgot the passphrase cannot find the reset from the Unlock dialog; 'Use a recovery file instead' leads to a dialog whose text says the passphrase opens the drive and offers 'Use my passphrase instead', a loop. Reset exists only as the last button in the key chip menu.
expected: A 'Forgot your passphrase?' link in the Unlock dialog (and not a loop in the recovery dialog).
actual: Verified: unlock dialog has only Unlock and Use a recovery file instead.
suggested_fix: Add a Forgot passphrase link to the unlock dialog.

description: The 'Reset and remove all drives' button is disabled until RESET is typed, but renders at full opacity in solid red, so it looks active; typing lowercase 'reset' leaves it disabled without explanation.
expected: Disabled style (reduced opacity) and a hint on case.
suggested_fix: Apply the disabled style to .danger buttons; accept case-insensitive input.

description: After the reset the dialog silently becomes 'Set up passphrase unlock'; no message says the account key was deleted, and the final notice ('Your agent can now add its drives') says nothing about re-pinning agents with account seal --repin --fingerprint or the new fingerprint.
expected: A line confirming the reset and the next step for agents, with the new fingerprint.
suggested_fix: Show 'Passphrase reset. Run agent-drive account seal --repin --fingerprint "d845 ed60 45b1 0d10" on each agent machine.'

description: Reset copy says 'removes every drive from it' next to 'Files are not deleted' and 'loading its recovery file', which confuses a user who has no recovery files; the recovery dialog text for a console-created drive talks about an agent that has the key.
expected: Plain wording: 'Your files stay. Each drive will need its key added again (from a recovery file or your agent).'
suggested_fix: Rewrite and make the agent hint conditional.

description: The Load-the-key dialog packs two long help paragraphs with inline code and Copy buttons under the main drop zone.
NOT WALKABLE in this run: steps 9-12 (agent pin mismatch warning, account seal --repin) because device-flow login was rate limited.
suggested_fix: Re-run once the login limiter allows.
